text:
Ashley J: Heads up — OrionMed reporting spike in 5xxs and p99 on dedicated pool-3 since ~09:05 UTC. Customer SLA at risk, they called support. Need owners + short-term mitigation plan.
Jordan (oncall): I'm oncall — looking at traces now. Do we know if this is model-related or infra?
SRE Bot: alert: HIGH_ERROR_RATE service=redwood-serving pool=dedicated-pool-3 spike_start=2026-03-18T09:04:12Z current_rate=7.8%
Mike R: I see a correlated increase in KV cache misses for requests routed to /v1/generate -> looks like a cache invalidation storm after the rollout yesterday. PR 6123 modified cache keys for multi-tenant routing.
Priya S: Yep, PR 6123 is the suspect. The change made cache keys dependent on `routing_id` which was null for some legacy customers — those requests bypassed cache and overloaded the backend. We should fallback routing to legacy-key behavior.
Sanjay K: I can own a hotpatch to short-circuit to the legacy key if `routing_id == null`. Will open a small PR. ETA ~45m for deploy if we get a quick review.
Lia P: Can you post the PR link here and add a short runbook snippet for rollback steps? Support wants an ETA we can share with OrionMed.
Sanjay K: PR -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/serving/pulls/6199 quick diff:
```
- cacheKey = fmt("%s:%s", model, routing_id)
+ cacheKey = routing_id != nil ? fmt("%s:%s", model, routing_id) : fmt("%s:legacy", model)
```
Jordan (oncall): I can review the PR right now. Sanjay — plan to deploy to canary pool first? We should avoid full rollout until telemetry looks good.
Sanjay K: Canary first, yes. Canary plan: 10% pool-3 traffic for 15m, monitor 5xx and cache-hit ratio, then 50% for 15m, then 100%. I'll add automated rollback if 5xx > 1% over 5min.
Priya S: Also note dependency: this mitigates cache storm but we still have elevated latency from the model variant `acme-embed-v2` on pool-3. If canary shows reduced 5xx we should still consider routing some traffic to `acme-embed-v2-quant` for lower mem pressure. That requires a routing policy change in config service (PR 6201).
Mike R: I can cut PR 6201 after the hotpatch is validated. It's just a routing override: route customer=orionmed -> model=acme-embed-v2-quant. Quick rollback is a single config revert.
Ashley J: Support wants a customer-facing ETA. If we can canary within 45-60m and ramp in 30-45 after that, we can tell them ~2h for a full mitigation (hotpatch + routing tweak). Is that fair?
Jordan (oncall): That's reasonable. I'll standby for metrics and handle rollback if anything spikes. Also will page infra if we need extra GPUs.
Lia P: I'll update the incident doc and notify support with the 2h ETA. Please ping me the canary completion message so I can update status.
Sanjay K: Rolling deploy started: canary -> pool-3-canary. Link to deploy: https://deploys.redwood/internal/serving/6199
Mike R: Pinged @priay and @jordan as reviewers on PR 6199. If you approve I can prepare PR 6201 for routing.
Priya S: Reviewing now. Quick note: add a unit test for null routing_id case and a telemetry counter `cache_bypass_legacy` so we can track reduction.
Sanjay K: Added test + telemetry. Pushed 2 commits.
Jordan (oncall): Canary at 10% for 15m. Initial 5m metrics: 5xx down from 7.8% -> 1.1%, cache-hit ratio improved ~22%. Will update at 15m mark.
Ashley J: Great. Lia, tell support we'll provide a 2h mitigation ETA and then a follow-up if we route to quant variant (minor cost impact).
Lia P: Noted, messaging going out now.
Jordan (oncall): 15m check: 5xx stable ~0.9%, latency p95 down ~18%. Recommend ramp to 50%.
Sanjay K: Ramping to 50% now.
Mike R: I'll start drafting PR 6201 for routing override — should be ready by the time canary completes.
Priya S: If 50% stays good, we can do full rollout and then apply routing. Keep an eye on token throughput — quant variant will increase token latency for some prompts.
Ashley J: Owners: Sanjay = hotpatch & rollout, Mike = routing PR, Jordan = oncall/rollback, Priya = QA/telemetry, Lia = customer comms. If anyone needs support, @eng-sre please standby.
SRE Bot: incident: update status=mitigating alert=HIGH_ERROR_RATE incident_id=INC-20260318-08
Jordan (oncall): Thanks everyone. Sanjay — ping when 50% stable and any anomalies.
Sanjay K: 50% stable after 20m, 5xx ~0.6%, cache-hit ratio +35%. Proceeding to 100% now.
Lia P: Support has sent the customer the 2h ETA and will notify after full mitigation.
Ashley J: Thank you all. Please leave short notes in the incident doc with timestamps for audit. :thumbsup:
